description: Set margins, column count and gutter on document pages and, by default, master pages, and redistribute the column guides evenly (relative to the type area). Whatever is omitted stays as it is. margins_mm takes top, left, bottom, right in mm – for facing pages "left" is the inside margin (Bundsteg) and "right" the outside margin. column_count 1–30, column_gutter_mm. page_ids[] limits the change to those pages (document or master pages); without it every page and the document defaults for new pages are changed – a client may block one call over all pages, so pass page_ids in blocks if needed. Optional baseline_grid {start_mm, increment_pt, relative_to: top_of_page | top_of_margin} sets the document baseline grid (Grundlinienraster). Moves only guides, never frames – unless move_objects is true: then every object on the changed pages keeps its size and moves with the inside (Bundsteg) and top margin (on a left-hand page of facing pages to the left when the inside margin grows), e.g. to widen the gutter for binding without stretching the type; locked objects, objects on locked layers and objects reaching beyond the page edge (bleeding images) stay and are listed in skipped_objects[] {item_id, page_id, reason}, moved ones in moved_objects[] {item_id, page_id, dx_mm, dy_mm}; changing the outside margin alone moves nothing. Returns changed_pages[] {page_id, name, margins_mm, column_count, column_gutter_mm, type_area_mm, column_width_mm, columns_positions_mm} read back from InDesign, with a warning per page whose column positions do not lie on the even grid. A timed-out call may still have completed in InDesign – check with get_layout_grid before repeating.

baseline_grid.description: Document baseline grid (Grundlinienraster); document-wide, not per page.

start_mm.description: Start of the baseline grid in mm.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

include_parent_pages.description: Also include master pages (Musterseiten). Default true.

margins_mm.description: Margins in mm; omitted edges stay.

move_objects.description: true: move the objects on the changed pages with the inside and top margin instead of leaving them (no resizing). Default false.

page_ids.description: Pages to change (document or master pages). Without it: all pages plus the document defaults.

name: set_layout_grid
title: Set margins and columns
